A1.justification: Both PDFs describe ConsistCompose and contain readable main text, equations, tables, figures, and complete supplementary material. Visual inspection resolves extraction differences, allowing retained content to be matched across relocation and renumbering.

before.justification: v1 reports original generation and understanding evaluations, including COCO-Position, MS-Bench, DreamBench, and Coordinate-CFG ablations.

after.justification: v3 retains these original results and adds editing evaluation, further baseline comparisons, and qualitative failure cases.

M1.justification: The Bagel/MoT backbone, instance-coordinate prompts, Coordinate-CFG, training objectives, and two-stage training procedure remain unchanged. Expanded terminology and revised guidance notation do not introduce a different method.

E1.justification: v3 adds GEdit/GEdit-Bench-EN evaluation of instruction-driven image editing, extending the existing multimodal evaluation suite. Training sources and the previous generation, understanding, and randomized-layout coverage are retained.

E2.justification: Table 1 and Figure 5 replace MIGC with PlanGen while retaining MIGC++. New Table S11 evaluates QwenImage and Nano Banana on COCO-Position. Other comparator sets remain unchanged; Step1X-Editing already appeared in v1's DreamBench comparisons.

E3.justification: The added editing evaluation reports SC, PQ, and OS for Bagel Base and variants with and without coordinate data. Existing benchmark protocols, Coordinate-CFG settings, and reported training budgets are unchanged.

E4.justification: Appendix D extends the coordinate-data ablation to editing and adds Figure S10's cases of inconsistent interactions and unintended additions. Existing guidance-strength sweeps, dense-layout examples, and other ablations are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, evaluation seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. v3's additional results retain point-estimate reporting.

E6.justification: Existing shared results remain unchanged, including ConsistCompose's COCO-Position mIoU/AP of 85.3/70.9. v3 adds PlanGen results, QwenImage/Nano Banana scores, and editing results: Table 3 reports GEdit 6.68/6.23/6.31 for Bagel/without/with coordinates, with component scores in Table S8. MIGC's COCO results are removed, and new qualitative failures are reported.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulations retain their meaning. Appendix B adjusts dropped-condition notation, and Equation 13 removes an extraneous unit factor. These are notation corrections, without new assumptions, derivations, proofs, or substantive mathematical changes.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: LELG, the unified ConsistCompose framework, and ConsistCompose3M. The headline layout improvements and general-capability claims remain unchanged.

C2.justification: Appendix D newly attributes interaction failures and unintended additions to difficulties with global geometry and occlusion/contact consistency. It also interprets the editing comparison as showing a mild training-related decline with little additional regression from coordinate data, and discusses general generators' difficulty satisfying explicit layouts.

D1.justification: Appendix D newly specifies matched data mixtures and optimization recipes for the with/without-coordinate variants. This clarifies the control rather than establishing changed training. Hyperparameters, hardware, data-construction procedures, prompt templates, and resource-access information otherwise remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v3 adds the Step1X-Edit reference and a limited discussion contrasting its spatial control with general-purpose image generators. PlanGen was already cited in v1. The related-work sections and central novelty positioning are otherwise retained.

P1.justification: v3 expands ICBP at its introduction, edits notation and wording, changes author ordering, and reorganizes Appendix D's capability discussion around generation, editing, and understanding. The overall narrative and section structure remain stable.

P2.justification: Table 3 gains a GEdit column; Tables S8 and S11 and failure Figure S10 are added. Figure 5 updates its comparator columns, Figure S8 is relocated, and qualitative bounding-box overlays are corrected. Other appendix displays are principally retained and renumbered.

improvement.justification: The additional comparisons, controlled editing evaluation, and explicit failure cases improve empirical coverage and transparency. The gain is limited because the core method and previous results are unchanged. Editing evidence is mixed: coordinates improve SC/PQ over the control but lower OS from 5.87 to 5.78, with both variants below Bagel's 6.36. The revision is more informative without fully resolving its broad capability-preservation claims.
